Army Pays Tribute to Two Special Forces Soldiers Lost in Hathnikund Barrage Tragedy

The Indian Army has paid tribute to two Special Forces soldiers who died in a boat accident at the Hathnikund Barrage on September 1. The Western Command held a ceremony to honor the fallen commandos. The incident occurred at the barrage, a key water management facility.
